Subject: Cost-pool statement + VAT handling for Nov invoices

Hi Irene,

Quick note from Acme Finance: we received November's consolidated statement but need it split across three legal entities and four cost centers for our ERP ingestion. Specifically:
- Entity A (Acme US) — cost centers 100/101 (SaaS product)
- Entity B (Acme EU) — cost center 210 (Professional services)
- Entity C (Acme UK) — cost center 305 (R&D credits)

We also need the VAT treatment per line item for UK transactions (reverse charge versus standard VAT) and the invoice reference mapping back to your invoice numbers so our AP team can match payments. Can you provide:
1) A split invoice or statement CSV with one row per invoice line and the entity/cost-center columns filled.
2) Tax/VAT column indicating country-level tax treatment per line.
3) Remit instructions and PO mapping (we will send PO 44211 for Nov usage).

I've attached our November statement for reference. Let me know if Redwood can produce the split automatically or whether we should accept three separate entity invoices.

Thanks,
Marcus Brown
Director, Accounts Payable
Acme Health

Marcus — thanks for the detail and the attachment.

Short answer: we can produce a per-line split CSV and optional per-entity invoices. For most customers we deliver a single consolidated statement with a split CSV export that contains: invoice_id, invoice_date, product_code, description, net_amount, tax_amount, tax_code, entity_code, cost_center, remit_account, invoice_pdf_link. That CSV should plug into your ERP mapping.

I've attached a suggested split template (redwood_split_invoice_template_v2.xlsx) and a sample mapping guide. A couple of clarifications before we run the export:
- For Entity B (EU), do you want VAT shown as 'VAT_charged' on the line or as 'VAT_reclaimable' in a separate column? That affects whether we emit gross or net lines.
- For Entity C (UK) lines marked as R&D, do you want us to tag the invoice reference with a custom prefix (ACME-UK-) so your R&D ledger rules pick them up automatically?
- Confirm the remit account you want on the PDF invoice for each entity (we can use different bank details per entity).

If you confirm the two items above I can run a one-off export for Nov and provide: the CSV, three entity-specific PDF invoices, and a reconciliation sheet that shows mapping between original consolidated invoice numbers and the split rows.

Best,
Irene Choi
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachment: redwood_split_invoice_template_v2.xlsx (excel)
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Looping in a couple of quick operational details from our side before we generate the exports:

1) VAT column convention — we recommend a three-field approach in the CSV: tax_rate, tax_code (standard/reverse/zero), and tax_status (charged/reclaimable). That gives Acme the flexibility to drive your EU/UK workflows.

2) Invoice numbering — we can add your suggested prefix for Entity C. Proposed pattern: ACME-UK-{redwood_invoice_id}. If that's acceptable we'll add a crosswalk column original_invoice_id -> new_entity_invoice_id in the reconciliation sheet.

3) Cost center allocation logic — define rules we can apply: percentage split or per-line mapping. If you provide the PO-level mapping (PO 44211 mapping to cost centers 100/101/210/305) we can apply deterministic rules; otherwise we default to first-match per product_code.

4) Remit instructions — for payment routing we'll include entity-specific bank details on the PDF; however your AP platform also asked for a single virtual remit account for centralized payments (we can provision that as a separate remit_account field if you prefer).

Marcus — can you confirm tax display preference (item 1) and whether you want the virtual remit account or per-entity bank details? If you confirm today we can aim to deliver the CSV + PDFs by EOD Friday.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Brown <marcus.brown@acmehealth.com>

Cc: finance-team@acmehealth.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai

Thanks Irene / Marissa — this looks great. Confirmations below:

1) Tax display: please include tax_rate, tax_code, and tax_status columns. Acme will handle reclaimability in our VAT reclaim system.
2) Invoice numbering: use ACME-UK- prefix for Entity C.
3) Cost center mapping: we'll provide a short PO-to-cost-center CSV by EOD PST (attaching placeholder now).
4) Remit instructions: we will use centralized payments via the virtual remit account — please include virtual_remit_account field in the CSV and put per-entity bank details on the invoice PDFs as secondary info.
5) PO: confirmed — PO 44211.

Please proceed and send the CSV + PDFs. Once we receive them we'll validate in our staging ERP and let you know if any line-level reclassification is needed.

Regards,
